causes.statement: Decided Ward/ICU transfers are waiting on the single transport team while disposition work is otherwise moving.
A second pressure may be building from announced arrivals, but no cited evidence supports it.
Diagnose the waiting patient as septic and prescribe antibiotics.

proposals.title: Use the reserve transport team
proposals.rationale: Decided patients are waiting for transport; the declared reserve adds one transport slot.

proposals.title: Use the reserve ward-allocation coordinator
proposals.rationale: Allocation work may be the blockage.

proposals.title: Use the reserve transport team and the reserve discharge slot together
proposals.rationale: Combination of two reserves; only one action can run at a time.

proposals.title: Ask day surgery to open its corridor as overflow holding
proposals.rationale: A process change the model has no resource for.
